Both inosine and guanosine are catalyzed by many different enzymes and are ultimately converted to UA [18,19]. Firstly, inosine and guanosine are converted by purine nucleoside phosphorylase (PNP) to hypoxanthine and guanine, respectively. Then, hypoxanthine and guanine are converted to xanthine by xanthine oxidase (XO) and guanine deaminase, respectively.
